title: Customer Page Count
prompt: A C# API paginates customers. Write a function that returns the number of pages needed for a total item count and page size.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Customer Page Count, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A C# API paginates customers. Write a function that returns the number of pages needed for a total item count and page size. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in C# using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
